proof:
Source: the 'Consequence' paragraph of step 1 of the parent node's supplied proof of the mass formula M_W(T) = R.measure W. Notation (shared with the parent proof): ℝ^P = Euclid P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) with standard orthonormal basis e_i = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i; Λ^n = Covector (Euclid P) n, the continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P; for a family b : Fin P → ℝ^P and j : Fin n → Fin P write b∘j := (b_{j(0)}, …, b_{j(n−1)}); |α|_E := covectorEuclideanNorm α = √(Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P} [I strictly increasing] α(e∘I)²) (SimonGMT Chapter06/Mass.lean). Uses the sibling lemmas regcomp_covector_eval_orthonormal_le (|α(τ)| ≤ |α|_E for orthonormal τ) and regcomp_exists_covector_eval_orthonormal_eq_one (∃ β₀, |β₀|_E = 1 ∧ β₀(τ) = 1).

1. (Unpack.) By IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q there is τ : Fin n → ℝ^P with Orthonormal ℝ τ (the span condition is not needed) and either (+) ξ(α) = α(τ) for all α, or (−) ξ(α) = −α(τ) for all α. Let β₀ be given by regcomp_exists_covector_eval_orthonormal_eq_one for τ: |β₀|_E = 1 and β₀(τ) = 1.

2. (Case +.) (i) |ξ(α)| = |α(τ)| ≤ |α|_E by regcomp_covector_eval_orthonormal_le. (ii) Take β := β₀: |β₀|_E = 1 ≤ 1 and ξ(β₀) = β₀(τ) = 1.

3. (Case −.) (i) |ξ(α)| = |−α(τ)| = |α(τ)| ≤ |α|_E by regcomp_covector_eval_orthonormal_le. (ii) Take β := −β₀: |−β₀|_E = |β₀|_E = 1 (covectorEuclideanNorm_neg) and ξ(−β₀) = −((−β₀)(τ)) = β₀(τ) = 1.

4. In both cases (i) and (ii) hold. ∎
